scope: On the Becoming core's flows: a quantity carried only by the exchanges taking part balances the levels it is read on exactly where no condition produces it, and conservation of the total alone does not give balance; read in available work relative to an environment at T0 > 0, the first law and the entropy balance at each store give Flow.Balances exactly where no store generates entropy, and at each exchange give the exergy balance with T0 times the generated entropy destroyed, so balance, Flow.Gainless and Flow.Dissipative come from one reading (premises jointly met in Burning). An exergy balance with the second law (no exchange destroys negative exergy) gives Flow.Gainless; with strict irreversibility of every taking exchange, or a floor of destroyed exergy at least the unit, it gives Flow.Dissipative; a floor counts r units at an r-fold finer unit; destroying at least a (q+1)th of what is taken gives Flow.DissipativeBy q. Over runs drawn from a measure, pathwise balance with dissipation in expectation bounds the expected takers and the summed probabilities of taking by the expected stock, and taking does not recur almost surely; Fluctuation gains on one run while dissipated on in expectation; the integral fluctuation theorem gives a non-negative expected entropy production and an exponential bound on gains. That a physical system's amounts are available work, that its stores and exchanges meet these premises, and Landauer's bound itself are correspondences, not checked.
